titulo: Handing the great idea back to its owner
caption:
Handing the great idea back to its owner

The group says great idea to whoever spoke last. My friend hands it back to its owner.

Saying whose idea it was costs nothing, and it lets the person see their own work land.

For whoever gives the credit back out loud.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A stairwell. A navy block figure on the right looks down with narrowed eyes. A ink-black block figure with white eyes on the left pulses, steps closer and a bubble says that was your idea. The navy one looks up with wide eyes and turns happy, and a bubble says you noticed! Both end with happy eyes. The text stays: me handing the credit back.
